damas.name_ko: 서호주 주 전역 (WA State-wide · 퍼스 및 지방) DAMA

damas.age_rule_en: Skill Levels 1–4: Under 55 (175 occs) | Skill Level 5: Under 50 (18 occs)

damas.pr_rule_en: 2 years full-time (35h/wk, or part-time equivalent) in the Kimberley. Counts work on NON-DAMA temporary visas toward Direct ENS 186! SL5 transitions directly without promotion.
damas.pr_rule_ko: 킴벌리 내 2년 풀타임(주 35시간 또는 파트타임 환산) 근무 후 186 전환. 워홀·졸업생 등 비-DAMA 비자 경력 합산하여 Direct ENS 186 신청 가능! SL5도 승진 없이 바로 186 가능.

The applicant must meet the following requirements: If required to undertake a skills assessment by the Minister, the applicant must undergo a skills assessment by the DAR (Department for Industry, Innovation and Science). At least an AQF Bachelor or higher qualification, or equivalent qualifications and have at least 5 years of recent and relevant work experience; OR At least 10 years of relevant work experience with at least five years of recent and relevant work experience. Have at least one (1) year of relevant work experience if applying for a TSS or SESR visa where the relevant AQF qualification was obtained in Australia; OR Have at least two (2) years of relevant work experience if applying for a TSS or SESR visa; OR Have at least three (3) years of relevant work experience if applying for an ENS visa. Work experience: must be in the nominated occupation, or a related occupation at the same skill level; must be undertaken in the last 5 years (either full-time or part-time pro-rata); can be undertaken prior to commencing study, while studying or post-qualification; can include experience gained while studying through a formal arrangement such as internships, industry and clinical placements, apprenticeships and traineeships, and work experience required through the Job Ready Program; can be served concurrently with any work experience used to substitute for formal qualifications as per ANZSCO requirements, provided that work experience was at the same skill level.

AND Work experience undertaken in lieu of a qualification can be served concurrently. Work experience must be: in the nominated occupation, or a related occupation at the same skill level must be undertaken in the last 5 years full-time or part-time pro-rata can be while studying through a formal arrangement such as internships, industry and clinical placements, apprenticeships and traineeships, and work experience required through the Job Ready Program, and can be served concurrently with any work experience used to substitute for formal qualifications as per ANZSCO requirements, provided that work experience was at the same skill level. occupations.pr_pathway_summary: 2 yrs FT on SA DAMA 482
occupations.quals_and_experience:
Nominees for this occupation must satisfy the skills, qualifications, experience and employment background required under the standard TSS, SESR or ENS visa programs except : Only one (1) year of relevant work experience is required for the TSS visa program; OR Only one (1) year of relevant work experience is required for the SESR visa programs where the relevant AQF qualification was obtained in Australia Only two (2) years of relevant work experience is required for the SESR visa program in addition to the qualification. Work experience undertaken in lieu of a qualification can be served concurrently. Work experience must be: in the nominated occupation, or a related occupation at the same skill level. must be undertaken in the last 5 years. full-time or part-time pro-rata. can be while studying through a formal arrangement such as internships, industry and clinical placements, apprenticeships and traineeships, and work experience required through the Job Ready Program. can be served concurrently with any work experience used to substitute for formal qualifications as per ANZSCO requirements, provided that work experience was at the same skill level. In cases where work experience is used to substitute for formal qualifications:
Skill level 1 occupations, which require 5 years of experience to substitute for a formal qualification, work experience must be undertaken within the last 8 years.
occupations.skills_authority: The applicant must satisfy the skills assessment requirements under the standard TSS, SESR or ENS visa programs.

occupations.pr_pathway_summary: 2 yrs FT on SA DAMA 482
occupations.quals_and_experience:
Nominees for this occupation must satisfy the skills, qualifications, experience and employment background required under the standard TSS, SESR or ENS visa programs except : Only one (1) year of relevant work experience is required for the TSS visa program; OR Only one (1) year of relevant work experience is required for the SESR visa programs where the relevant AQF qualification was obtained in Australia Only two (2) years of relevant work experience is required for the SESR visa program in addition to the qualification. Work experience undertaken in lieu of a qualification can be served concurrently. Work experience must be: in the nominated occupation, or a related occupation at the same skill level. must be undertaken in the last 5 years. full-time or part-time pro-rata. can be while studying through a formal arrangement such as internships, industry and clinical placements, apprenticeships and traineeships, and work experience required through the Job Ready Program. can be served concurrently with any work experience used to substitute for formal qualifications as per ANZSCO requirements, provided that work experience was at the same skill level. In cases where work experience is used to substitute for formal qualifications:
Skill level 1 occupations, which require 5 years of experience to substitute for a formal qualification, work experience must be undertaken within the last 8 years.
occupations.skills_authority: The applicant must satisfy the skills assessment requirements under the standard TSS, SESR or ENS visa programs.

Nominees for this occupation must satisfy the skills, qualifications, experience and employment background required under the standard TSS, SESR or ENS visa programs except : Only one (1) year of relevant work experience is required for the TSS visa program; OR Only one (1) year of relevant work experience is required for the SESR visa programs where the relevant AQF qualification was obtained in Australia Only two (2) years of relevant work experience is required for the SESR visa program in addition to the qualification. Work experience undertaken in lieu of a qualification can be served concurrently. Work experience must be: in the nominated occupation, or a related occupation at the same skill level. must be undertaken in the last 5 years. full-time or part-time pro-rata. can be while studying through a formal arrangement such as internships, industry and clinical placements, apprenticeships and traineeships, and work experience required through the Job Ready Program. can be served concurrently with any work experience used to substitute for formal qualifications as per ANZSCO requirements, provided that work experience was at the same skill level. In cases where work experience is used to substitute for formal qualifications:
Skill level 1 occupations, which require 5 years of experience to substitute for a formal qualification, work experience must be undertaken within the last 8 years.

Work Experience must be: In the nominated occupation, or a related occupation at the same skill level. At least 20 hours per week. Undertaken within the last 3 years (TSS/SESR) or 5 years (ENS). Can be undertaken prior to commencing study, while studying or post-qualification. Can be undertaken as part of a formal arrangement such as internships, industry and clinical placements, apprenticeships and traineeships, and work experience required through the Job Ready Program (JRP). Can be served concurrently with any work experience used to substitute for formal qualifications as per ANZSCO requirements, provided that the work experience was at the same skill level. In cases where work experience is used to substitute for formal qualifications: Skill Level 2 and 3 occupations, which require 3 years of experience to substitute for a formal qualification, work experience must be undertaken within the last 5 years.
